findings.rationale: Valid: the figures are driver first-response costs. Section 0 relabels them and states no estimate from them; P1 Step 2 derives full-run cost from copied logs and needs owner acknowledgement before launch.
Valid: an opposite reading is a prediction, not a control. Section 2 now pairs every trial with a matched baseline that changes only the hook decision (A0, B0, C0).
Valid: labels C and D over-interpreted two Fisher tests. Section 3.3 now describes them as not rejected against either and rejected against both, with no diagnosis.
Valid: old-harness runs had no stopping rule. They are removed from the plan; candidate 4 is a diff read only.
Valid: result.json was not copied. Step 1 and section 3.1 now copy and hash it and name the source of record per metric.

Valid: historical run.log files carry no invocation line. Section 3.2 reconstructs the C-only command from the pinned driver and harness, states that provenance, and marks historical invocation evidence unavailable.
Valid: the generation count was inconsistent. Sections 0, 5 and the review log now say six generations in three rounds.
Valid: run-t14-gate-batch.js always schedules G enforce runs. Section 3.2 forbids using it and specifies 30 direct harness invocations from a scratch wrapper, BLOCKED if that needs a harness edit.
Valid: n and incomplete handling were open. Section 3.3 freezes n=30 with every launched run counted and incompletes scored on the repo as left.
Valid: several candidate rows lacked a closed mapping. Section 3.4 now gives an observation-to-label function per candidate over four labels, drops the old-harness runs, and drops the symptom row.

Valid: isolation and the second-block trial were missing. Section 2 now requires proven isolation from plugin hooks, trials A1 and A2, and per-trial labels, with expected readings committed before any run.
Valid: same as 7.
Valid: the closed number list contradicted section 3.4. Section 0 now says other historical numbers are P1 outputs, and section 3.4 no longer states them.
Valid: GO fired with unproduced hook answers. Section 3.5 now requires A1 and B1 affirmative.

Valid: missing preconditions. Section 1 adds BLOCKED on a wrong CLI version or failed authentication probe, and Step 2 requires a cost estimate acknowledged before launch; extra candidate-4 runs are removed.
Valid: same family as 2 and 11. Closed by the trials A0, A1, A2, B0, B1, C0, C1 with matched baselines and per-trial labels.
Valid: the driver cannot run C-only without replacement. Closed by the driver-free procedure with a committed manifest, single invocation per id, existing-output refusal, and logged invocations.
Valid: same as 10. Closed by the closed mapping function; candidate 8 moved to supplementary observations.
Valid: validity was not conjunctive. Section 3.3 now lists every condition, makes any failure label U, and states how resolved model ids are handled.
Valid: same as 14. Closed by the GO rule in section 3.5.
Valid: raw artifacts conflicted with the policy. Section 1 now has one artifact policy: raw logs and hook output stay in scratch, the repo gets derived notes, redacted excerpts and a sums file.

Valid: runtime identity was open. Section 1 preregisters the CLI path and version 2.1.303, dedicated config directory seeded only with credentials, version and authentication preflight, BLOCKED on failure, and U on mid-window expiry.
